KuroCat web renderer, vendored from https://kurocat.cc/pet/ on 2026-11-27.
Upstream: https://github.com/chanke17/KuroCat (Copyright 2026 chanke17).
Original MIT license is included in LICENSE. spec.js is unmodified. renderer.js adds a hideEquipment drawScene option to omit the keyboard, mouse and tablet in idle and scruff-drag poses.
